assumptions: Integers n>=4k, k>=2, 1<=i<=n; 1<ik/n<=2; H hypergeometric counting marked objects in k draws without replacement.
integrity: Exact coefficient interpolation proof and independent-readable standard-library checker, not independently validated or peer reviewed.
scientific_limitations: The bound is confined to the one-to-two mean strip; higher expected counts, the complete conjectural n>=4k range, and general MMS populations are unproved. Unindexed priority risk remains.
title: Sharp quarter-tail bound in the one-to-two hypergeometric mean strip
